sources.citation: Lithgow, David R. 1976. Austronesian languages: Milne Bay and adjacent islands (Milne Bay Province). In S. A. Wurm (ed.), New Guinea Area Languages and Language Study, vol. 2: Austronesian languages, 441-523. Pacific Linguistics C-39. Canberra: ANU.
sources.note: Section 84 'Stress' (p. 475) is a Papuan-Tip-Cluster-wide remark: vowel lengthening near the end of the phonological word; stress phonemic in Kilivila, Muyuw, Budibud, Misima; 'In all of the languages of PTC it seems that stress is predictable within certain word-classes.. the stress moves one syllable closer to the end of the word' under suffixation. Kukuya (= Minaveha, sec. 28 p. 455) is covered by the survey but not named in sec. 84; no Minaveha-specific stress position given.
sources.venue: New Guinea Area Languages and Language Study
